purpose: Redeploy diasrecords with the step 13 visibility rules and verify the system on the running host
screensChecked: access log as sp.north (six rows, every case)
request access as insp.sharma (denied request, real explanation)

securityReview.verdict: Warning: 1 high, 2 medium, 6 low; none critical
fixedBeforeSecondDeploy: high: the requester rule now comes before reviewer and auditor rights (contract and backend); a district head never reviews their own request
medium: the private evidence detail is scoped to the district
medium: one unreadable stored review no longer breaks the auditor queue; entries of an earlier key are re-sealed at start-up; unreadable entries are counted

low: fixed authentication-tag length; plaintext entries refused by an encrypted store after start-up; writes flushed before rename; the requester never sees the note digest; a missing explanation is no longer reported as "no recommendation"
leftAsDocumentedLimits: the lifecycle chaincode event carries the generation status
reviewer and member reads trust the certificate, not the ledger profile
older reviews in backend/data/dias-reviews/ (not the running store) are still in the clear
DIAS_TRACE_FILE logs recommendation values in the clear when enabled
